title: Automorphism-invariant refinements of weakly branch actions via overlap functions
summary: Let a finitely generated group $G$ act weakly branch on a locally finite rooted tree $T$ with boundary $\partial T$. The rooted tree structure is encoded by the \textit{overlap function}, which is our name for the Gromov product on the boundary: \[ c(ξ,η)=|ξ\wedgeη|. \] We axiomatise this function and show that when it is `admissible', one can recover the rooted tree. By the boundary rigidity theorem of Lavreniuk and Nekrashevych, $\operatorname{Aut}(G)$ acts canonically on $\partial T$.
